title: India just took bids to build the magnets inside every EV motor and wind turbine
sources: PIB / Cabinet, November 2025 - Rare Earth Permanent Magnet scheme approval, Rs 7,280 crore
Ministry of Heavy Industries, August 2026 - 20 bids received for REPM production-linked incentive
caption:
Every EV motor and wind turbine needs a rare earth magnet. Last year, India imported 93% of them from one country. Last month, 20 companies bid to change that.

India's Cabinet approved a Rs 7,280 crore scheme in November 2025 to build a domestic rare earth permanent magnet industry. In FY25, India imported 53,700 tonnes of these magnets - 93% of it from China. By August 2026, 20 bids had come in from companies including L&T, Coal India and ReNew, targeting 6,000 tonnes of annual production capacity. Winners haven't been picked yet - the bids are still being evaluated.

The dependence is 93%. The bids are in. What gets built next decides who makes India's motors.

Sources: PIB/Cabinet, Ministry of Heavy Industries (2025-2026)
